# Dagr reusable recipes

> Independently consumable recipes for Dagr. The TypeScript recipe combines ordinary RDK nodes with contextual file, command, and target contributions; the RDK recipe provides the graph primitive.

## Start here

- [Recipes overview](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/recipes/README.md): recipe boundaries, publication, mounting, and validation.
- [TypeScript recipe](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/recipes/typescript/README.md): recipe builders, contextual contributions, products, capabilities, and package-manager graphs.
- [RDK](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/recipes/rdk/README.md): graphs, bindings, tags, shaking, and compilation.

## Agent guidance

- [Dagr Recipes Agent Skill](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/tree/main/.agents/skills/dagr-recipes): modeling rules and authoring workflow.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/caeus/dagr/blob/main/recipes/AGENTS.md): concise instructions for edits under `recipes/`.

## Validation

- `dagr run //recipes:ci:test`
- `dagr run //recipes:ci:image-rdk`
- `dagr run //recipes:ci:image-typescript`
